handle.title: Choose your handle
handle.body: This is the only name other members will ever see. Your real name, employer, specialty and grade are never shown.
handle.label: Handle
handle.rules: 3–30 characters. Letters, numbers, underscores and hyphens.
handle.permanentWarning: Your handle is permanent. You can't change it later — kudos and post history belong to it, so pick one you're happy to be known by.

unavailable.invalid_format: 3–30 characters, using letters, numbers, underscores or hyphens only.
unavailable.blocklisted: That handle isn't allowed. Names that could impersonate the platform or its staff are reserved.

handle.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.

setup.title: Before you start
setup.rule: Askapeer works because nobody knows who anyone is. Every member here is a verified, registered practitioner — but no one can tell whether you're a consultant of thirty years or six months out of your degree. That is the point: ideas are judged on merit, not rank.
setup.ruleConsequence: Any attempt to identify yourself or another member — in a post, a reply, or by arranging it off the platform — results in immediate and permanent removal from Askapeer. There are no exceptions and no appeals.
setup.acknowledge: I understand, and I agree not to identify myself or any other member
setup.error: We couldn't save that. Please try again.

anonymity.heading: Before you post — stay anonymous
anonymity.body: Never name yourself, a colleague, an employer or a patient. Identifying yourself or another member means permanent removal from Askapeer, with no exceptions.
